{{Quote|Our agents persuaded them to use the eatery in Uscru, and the factory in which you find yourself&mdash;owned by us, as it were, through a holding company called LiMerge Power.|Darth Plagueis, to Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''LiMerge Power''' was a company headquartered on [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]].

==History==
The company had substantive holdings at the [[LiMerge Building/Legends|LiMerge Building]] in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. LiMerge used [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]] as their planetary base for manufacturing. The planet was ultimately devastated when factories LiMerge built in the northern hemisphere reached hazardous levels and imploded.

[[File:Coruscant_abandoned_tower.png|thumb|left|200px|[[LiMerge Building/Legends|LiMerge Building]] in The Works]]
The company was rumored to have manufactured and sold illegal weapons during the time that [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. It also was believed to have funded [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raids against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that gave the Trade Federation the right to defend itself with [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. LiMerge was rumored to be controlled by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

In the [[recapture of Tythe]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] used [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] as bait to lure [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] into a trap in LiMerge's Tythe factory. In baiting Anakin Skywalker, Count Dooku angered the Jedi Knight. As a result, Skywalker collapsed a large section of the building in rage, using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Dooku's confidence was shaken by this.

==Behind the scenes==
In German, the company is called LeMerge instead of LiMerge.
